line: Tonight's aurora chances, where you are

versions.line: On the shelf, for any place

summary.message: Tells you each evening whether it's worth looking for the aurora from the place you choose: NOAA's Kp forecast and MET Norway's cloud cover, with the darkness and the moon worked out on its own. Tonight and the recent nights on its screen, and a widget.
summary.keeps: Your place (a name, coordinates and its time zone), one rated forecast per night, and the last answers from NOAA and MET Norway.
summary.reaches: NOAA for the Kp forecast, with nothing about you in it, and MET Norway with your place's coordinates rounded to two decimals (about a kilometre).

findings.title: Choosing another place deletes the stored nights
findings.detail: A night is rated for one place and time zone, so moving starts afresh, and an agent has to ask you first; renaming the place keeps them.

findings.title: Reaches only NOAA and MET Norway, the two hosts it asks for
The darkness, the moon and the ratings are worked out inside the tool
